## Author checklist (before requesting review)

<!-- Check only completed items. Mark non-applicable items N/A with a brief explanation. -->

- [ ] This PR is linked to a GitHub issue and addresses one coherent objective.
- [ ] The relevant acceptance criteria have been met, or remaining work is explicitly identified.
- [ ] I have reviewed my own changes and followed the repository conventions in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] Relevant tests or smoke checks have passed and are documented above.
- [ ] Documentation, dependencies and configuration have been updated where necessary.
- [ ] No credentials, restricted data or unnecessary large files are included.
- [ ] Where applicable, experiments are logged, reproducible, and evaluated using the agreed protocol without data leakage.

## Merge requirements

<!-- These are completed after review, not by the author before requesting review. -->

- [ ] Independent peer approval has been obtained, including approval of the latest reviewable push by someone other than its pusher.
- [ ] All review conversations are resolved and any configured required checks have passed.
- [ ] The PR will be merged into `main` using a regular merge commit (no squash or rebase).
